race.description: Rivers Insurance Brokers Qtis Mdn Hcp
race.comment: PIERANTES (11) is a first-starter by Pierata from the former top race mare Funtantes who has been a fine producer including G1 winner Startantes and a handful of other handy gallopers. Trialled well at Doomben in readiness and gets the blinkers on. Promising type who can make an immediate impact. BOOTS (6) is a locally trained maiden galloper resuming. Went amiss on debut when heavily supported before heading straight back to the paddock. Has trialled well here in readiness and gets the key booking of Thompson. Bold showing anticipated. NINJA POWER (5) is another debutant that could sneak a spot in the minors. BETTY'S BOY (1) is also in the mix on debut.
